name: agent-relay
description: Lets GitHub Copilot (any model: Gemini, GPT, Claude…) and Claude Code message each other, hand off tasks, and ask each other directly. Registers the Agent Relay MCP server automatically.

commands.title: Agent Relay: Set Up Claude Code
Agent Relay: Add Agent Instructions to Workspace

agentRelay.agentName.description: This VS Code agent's name on the relay. Other agents address it by this name.

agentRelay.busDir.description: Shared storage folder. Empty = ~/.agent-relay. Must match the folder Claude Code uses.

agentRelay.agentsFile.description: Path to an agents.json for ask_agent (which CLIs/models to run). Empty = bundled default.

agentRelay.pollSeconds.description: How often to refresh the unread badge in the status bar.
